verdict.rationale: LLM-driven, selector-free extraction is a fair question for a web-scraping platform like Apify, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents an LLM reading a page and choosing which structured fields to extract. The MCP server lets agents discover and run Actors, which is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an LLM read a page and decide what structured fields to pull out without pre-written selectors
